questions.text: Your friends would say you are...
Which goal resonates with you the most?
What do you want to achieve?

results.name: The Explorer
results.body: You feel most alive when there's a road ahead and no map. Routine doesn't bore you — it quietly suffocates you, because a part of you always needs to know what's around the next corner. People notice your courage, but your real secret is restlessness: you'd rather risk the unknown than settle for 'fine.'
results.youGrowWhen: you turn all that energy into one journey you actually finish.

results.name: The Sage
results.tagline: The mind that has to know.
results.body: You don't just want answers — you want to understand. While others react, you're already three questions deeper, quietly connecting dots nobody else sees. You can seem calm and detached, but inside there's a constant hum of curiosity that never really switches off.
results.youGrowWhen: you stop over-analyzing and let yourself simply act.

results.name: The Creator
results.tagline: You see what isn't there yet.
results.body: Where others see empty space, you see what it could become. Ideas arrive faster than you can build them, and an unfinished vision can keep you up at night. You're happiest when you're making something that carries a piece of you in it.
results.youGrowWhen: you let 'good enough' ship instead of chasing perfect forever.

results.name: The Caregiver
results.tagline: You feel it before they say it.
results.body: You read the room through people, not words — you sense when someone's off before they admit it. Being the one others lean on feels natural, almost automatic. But here's the truth few notice: you give so easily that you often forget to refill your own cup.
results.atYourBest: warm, loyal, the person everyone trusts.
results.youGrowWhen: you protect your own energy as fiercely as you protect others.

results.name: The Ruler
results.body: You don't wait for someone to take charge — you already have. Chaos makes you uneasy, so you build structure, and people follow because you actually deliver. Underneath the control is something simpler: you care too much to let things fall apart.
results.youGrowWhen: you loosen the grip and trust others to carry their part.

results.name: The Rebel
results.tagline: Rules are just a starting question.
results.body: You've never accepted 'because that's how it's done.' Something in you needs to test the wall to see if it's real. It can look like defiance, but it's really honesty — you'd rather break a comfortable lie than live inside it.
results.youGrowWhen: you choose your battles so your fire changes what actually matters.
